lines: Ashwini Amit Dixit, Promoter Group Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling up to 67,500 shares in the offer for sale.
Up to ₹9.13 crore, if all offered shares are sold; the money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago).
Retained shares are an estimate of ₹64.08 crore at offer price, unlocked since 9 Sep 2026, so more value may follow later.
Event was recent but the shares unlocked 67 days ago; proceeds are shown before offer expenses and taxes where gain applies.
